sourceInformation.genre: Sports, with a light life-sim routine
sourceInformation.perspective: 2.5D studio; three-quarter island; behind-the-skier Mode 7; pseudo-3D jogging; tilted tray; side-view clothesline.
sourceInformation.tech: HTML5 Canvas, JavaScript, my-3D2dge v0.89.0, native Web Audio, AI Hub client 1.4.0. Node build; Playwright 1.63.0 tests. Self-contained offline HTML.
sourceInformation.artDirection: Bright native pixel-art skeleton puppets, white paper, pale wood, cyan sea and coral clothing. Original retreat characters, props and UI.
sourceInformation.animation: Humanoid skeletons and IK; 23 bundled Mesh2Motion, Quaternius and CMU motion clips; blended poses; input-driven rail, step, hoop, ski and rope motion.
sourceInformation.audio: Original procedural synth music, SFX and letter-based gibberish voices via Web Audio. Music defaults to 10 percent. No audio files.
sourceInformation.online: AI Hub ghost mode for 1–4 players: seeded three-event Morning Class, shared clock, neighboring ghosts and scores. Local Class for 2–4 with split keyboard, pads and bots.
sourceInformation.testing: Deterministic simulations across 12 seeds; both tiers of all activities; full skilled and passive story runs; save, attract, dev and Class checks; controller stand-in; Web Audio analysis; 16 viewport/engine combinations; Chromium, WebKit and Firefox; five hub harness scenarios. Physical controller, real iOS Safari, TV and human listening results: unknown.
sourceInformation.research: Read PLAN.md, the handoff API, asset and animation documentation, and AI Hub protocol/source. No additional source-game research.
sourceInformation.environment: Codex CLI (headless); Linux, Ubuntu 26.04 on WSL2.

testingFeedback: 13 tracked issues were caught and fixed, including gameplay, input, rendering, readability and screenshot-capture problems. The issue log is in tests/issues.md.
2 were game-breaking: incorrect motion-clip sampling and undefined session options. The required attract start was also blocked and fixed.
The full scripted five-day playthrough, covering all twelve activities, the Day 3 plateau, festival, ending and Free Play.
The engine checker’s palette-density heuristic on intentionally sparse member menus was less useful than gameplay state checks.
engineFeedback: The same native skeleton rigs and motion clips work across studio, island, road and Mode 7 views, with procedural audio and deterministic stepping already available.
Yes. Mocap sampling requires clip objects rather than names. Headless draw:true also renders each advance even when its per-call draw option is false.
The shared Lean model and device-independent intent layer, then the activity registry, five-day progression and bright pill UI.
Coordinating depth-sorted actors with full-screen road and Mode 7 overlays, including correctly visible remote ghosts.
Made the three Dialog text shadows configurable so dark text remains crisp on white panels. No other engine changes.
Provide a clearly documented render-pass API for placing player rigs and ghosts over full-screen specialty renderers.
promptFeedback: The detailed plan supplied a clear cast, tone, mechanics, designer data formats and concrete acceptance tests.
The plan referenced v0.88.0 while the live handoff was v0.89.0; a few shorthand recipes still required checking exact API signatures.
Making twelve distinct activities share one balance skill while completing the story, local Class, online round, attract and developer tools.
Pin the engine commit and separate mandatory acceptance criteria from starting tuning values and aspirational pacing targets.

aiHub.name: Wee Serene
aiHub.description: Spend five days at a seaside wellness retreat where twelve gentle sports share one wobbly balance skill. A needy talking scale, two wooden instructors and a ceramic hippo will measure your very small improvements.
aiHub.controls: Lean: left stick, WASD/arrows or mouse; breathe/effort: L2/R2, Space or click; catch: L1/R1 or Q/E; jog: alternate L2/R2 or J/K; Cross/Enter confirms; Options/Esc pauses.
